title: 实验室安全，人人有责

points.K4: 安全设备随手可取、状态完好
points.K7: 熟悉应急程序和自己的角色
points.K9: 防护用品勤清洁、勤检查
points.S1: 三级管理，负责人第一责任
points.S4: 检查发现问题，限期整改

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the entrance of a university lab building and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：实验室安全，人人有责。

shots.scene: 一边是教学楼图标，一边是一群学生图标，中间双向箭头
shots.prompt_en: A university building icon on one side and a group of student pictograms on the other, joined by a two-way arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 学校有学校的责任，你有你的责任。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着墙上的灭火器，嘀咕
shots.prompt_en: The young male student glances at a fire extinguisher on the wall and shrugs.
shots.narration: 阿杰觉得：安全是老师和学校的事。

shots.scene: 老周笑着摇头，指了指阿杰，又指了指自己
shots.prompt_en: The older man smiles and shakes his head, pointing at the young male student and then at himself.
shots.narration: 老周说：学校要管，你自己也得管。

shots.scene: 王老师和老周在实验室门口交谈
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man talk at the lab door, both looking at a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 实验室安全，单位首先要担起责任。

shots.section_title: 针对本实验室制定应急预案
shots.scene: 王老师和老周对着空白应急预案文件讨论，旁边是实验室危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man discuss a blank emergency plan binder, with lab hazard pictograms floating beside it.
shots.narration: 针对本实验室的具体危害，制定应急预案。
overlay: 针对本实验室制定应急预案

shots.section_title: 针对本实验室制定应急预案
shots.scene: 火灾、溢洒、触电、受伤四个场景图标连到预案本
shots.prompt_en: Four icons of a fire, a spill, an electric shock and an injury, each linked by a line to a blank plan binder. No people.
shots.narration: 着火、溢洒、受伤，各怎么办都写清楚。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给学生上课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 定期培训每一个人。

shots.scene: 学生们沿疏散箭头有序走出实验室
shots.prompt_en: Students walk out of the lab in an orderly line along an evacuation arrow during a drill.
shots.narration: 组织演练，让每个人都知道该做什么。

shots.section_title: 安全设备随手可取、状态完好
shots.scene: 灭火器、洗眼器、溢洒处理箱三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a fire extinguisher, an eyewash station and a spill kit box. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器、洗眼器、溢洒处理箱，
overlay: 安全设备随手可取、状态完好

shots.section_title: 安全设备随手可取、状态完好
shots.scene: 老李检查灭火器压力表，并在空白卡上签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the pressure gauge of a fire extinguisher and signs a blank inspection tag.
shots.narration: 要随手可取，定期检查，保持完好。

shots.section_title: 安全设备随手可取、状态完好
shots.scene: 被纸箱挡住的洗眼器图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an eyewash station blocked by stacked boxes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能被杂物挡住。

shots.scene: 旧规程本被换成新规程本，旁边日历图标
shots.prompt_en: An old blank procedure binder is swapped for a new one, with a calendar icon and a refresh arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 有了新危害、新规定，规程要跟着改。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一条双向箭头中间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in the middle of a large two-way arrow.
shots.narration: 安全是双向的，每个人都有责任。

shots.section_title: 熟悉应急程序和自己的角色
shots.scene: 小研指着墙上的安全出口标志和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at an emergency exit sign and then at a fire extinguisher on the lab wall.
shots.narration: 熟悉应急程序：出口在哪，灭火器在哪。
overlay: 熟悉应急程序和自己的角色

shots.section_title: 熟悉应急程序和自己的角色
shots.scene: 阿杰胸前别着空白角色牌，站在集合点
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears a blank role badge and stands at an emergency assembly point sign.
shots.narration: 还要清楚，出事时自己负责什么。

shots.scene: 阿杰在培训课上认真记笔记
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes notes attentively during a safety training session.
shots.narration: 培训不是走过场，要认真学。

shots.scene: 演练时边走边聊天的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of people chatting and dawdling during an evacuation drill, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 演练要当真，把学到的记在心里。

shots.section_title: 防护用品勤清洁、勤检查
shots.scene: 小研举起护目镜对着光检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up her safety goggles to the light and checks them for scratches and cracks.
shots.narration: 个人防护用品，用前先检查。
overlay: 防护用品勤清洁、勤检查

shots.section_title: 防护用品勤清洁、勤检查
shots.scene: 破了的手套、裂了的护目镜图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a torn glove and cracked goggles, crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 破了、裂了，马上换新的。

shots.section_title: 防护用品勤清洁、勤检查
shots.scene: 小研擦拭护目镜后放回柜子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes her goggles clean and puts them back in a cabinet.
shots.narration: 用完清洁，妥善存放。

shots.scene: 阿杰发现地上的电线破皮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices a frayed power cord lying on the lab floor.
shots.narration: 发现隐患，

shots.scene: 阿杰拍照后向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a photo of the cord with his phone and reports it to the older man.
shots.narration: 马上报告，不要等出了事。

shots.scene: 小研一边做实验，一边留意周围同学
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at her bench while glancing around to check on her labmates and the room.
shots.narration: 时刻保持警觉，周围情况心中有数。

shots.scene: 小研提醒旁边的阿杰把烧瓶往里放
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points out to the young male student that his flask is too close to the bench edge.
shots.narration: 护好自己，也护好同伴。

shots.section_title: 三级管理，负责人第一责任
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层图标
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked icons: a university building at the top, a department building in the middle and a lab room at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 高校实验室安全，实行三级管理。
overlay: 三级管理，负责人第一责任

shots.section_title: 三级管理，负责人第一责任
shots.scene: 老周在实验室门口挂上空白负责人牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man hangs a blank name plate for the person in charge beside the lab door.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人，是本室安全第一责任人。

shots.section_title: 三级管理，负责人第一责任
shots.scene: 老周组织组会，讲本组安全要求
shots.prompt_en: The older man leads a group meeting, pointing at a blank safety rules sheet while students listen.
shots.narration: 导师和负责人，要把安全管到每个人。

shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑前参加安全考试，屏幕为空白和勾选图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a safety exam on a computer with a blank screen showing check box icons.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先培训、再考试。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白合格证走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank pass certificate and walks into the lab.
shots.narration: 合格了，才能进实验室做实验。

shots.scene: 没准入就进门的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person entering a lab door without a pass card, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 新仪器、新危险操作，还要专门培训。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着一张要他独自夜里做高危实验的便条，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank note left beside a risky setup with a moon and a single-person icon, then shakes his head and raises a hand.
shots.narration: 遇到违规要求或冒险作业，

shots.scene: 阿杰说明理由，并拿起电话报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student explains his concern and then picks up a phone to report.
shots.narration: 你有权拒绝，并向学院报告。

shots.scene: 危险迹象出现，小研停下手中操作快步撤离
shots.prompt_en: Warning lights flash and the female graduate student stops her work and walks quickly out of the lab.
shots.narration: 情况危急，可以先停下、先撤离。

shots.section_title: 检查发现问题，限期整改
shots.scene: 王老师带着空白检查表巡查实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through the lab with a blank inspection checklist, checking cabinets and equipment.
shots.narration: 学校和学院定期检查实验室。
overlay: 检查发现问题，限期整改

shots.section_title: 检查发现问题，限期整改
shots.scene: 检查—整改—复查三个环形箭头
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow cycle linking three icons: a magnifying glass, a wrench and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 发现问题，登记、整改、复查。

shots.section_title: 检查发现问题，限期整改
shots.scene: 老周带着学生把杂物清出通道
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student clear boxes out of a lab aisle.
shots.narration: 整改要按期完成，不拖不推。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现学校图标和学生图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a university building and a group of students.
shots.narration: 单位定预案、抓培训、管设备。

shots.scene: 应急出口、防护用品、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an exit sign, safety goggles and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 个人懂程序、护装备、报隐患。

shots.scene: 准入证和举手拒绝的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pass certificate and a raised hand saying no. No people.
shots.narration: 先准入，遇到冒险作业敢说不。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验楼前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a university lab building.
shots.narration: 安全靠大家，下次见！
